plots.title: Alia Edges Upward
plots.text: Alia has now finished 6 gameweeks in a row below the league average. This week's 50 points is a step up from 42, though the run of weeks below average continues.
plots.next: Could Alia string together a stronger week and begin to climb out of the slump?
plots.question: Can Alia snap out of it?

plots.title: Prem Closes the Gap
plots.text: Prem is now 5 points behind Rohan, down from 21 just one gameweek ago. The gap has shrunk every week since GW7, when Rohan was 34 points clear.

plots.question: Can Prem catch Rohan?

gamble:3506595:10.title: The Barry Gamble

title.title: Nikhil's One-Point Lead
title.text: Nikhil leads Matt by just 1 point, 723 to 722, after holding a 24-point cushion last week. Deepak sits 15 points further back, and the crown has changed hands 3 times this season.
